texts.zh: [target.GetName]上的奴隶们已经揭竿而起！在精心计划的袭击中，[target.GetName]上的激进分子躲过了当地政府的搜查，击溃了我们的快速反应部队。该行星因此陷入骚乱的状态，愤怒的奴隶们拉帮结派，拿着威力强大的武器冲上街道大肆破坏，攻击任何胆敢阻止他们的人。
texts.en: The slaves on [target.GetName] are rioting! In a carefully planned assault, radical elements on [target.GetName] escaped the local authorities, overwhelming our rapid response teams. The planet has since descended into a state of general disarray as mobs of enraged slaves, many armed with lethal weapons, have taken to the streets vandalizing and attacking all who stand in their way.

label.zh: 也许我们需要改变我们的策略。
label.en: Maybe we need to change our approach.
